verdicts.evidence: The title reads "Winter timetable at the harbour" and sits over six prose paragraphs in two columns; the only schedule wording is "every ninety minutes" and "the first crossing" in the second left paragraph, and no clock times appear anywhere.

All the passenger facts are in body paragraphs of the same weight; the waiting-room paragraph comes after the sailing-frequency paragraph and before the crossing-time paragraph at the top of the right column, and the three quoted phrases appear as written.
At about y≈585 there is a rule under "Fares and cards" in the left column and a matching rule in the right column with no heading above it, and nothing below either rule.
